title: Payout Methods Holding Terms: Number of Methods, Default and Rail Eligibility
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of methods.** A host account may hold up to 10 Payout Methods in any status other than removed, on any mix of rails.

**Clause 2 — The default method.** Exactly one active method is the default at any time. The first method added becomes the default.

**Clause 3 — Adding a rail.** A rail may be added only when the host's bank or receiver country is in the rail's available countries and the payout currency is in its supported currencies, and, where the rail requires the account holder name to match, only in the host's legal name or the account's business name.

## Clause 1 in counts

Methods that count toward the limit of 10 are those pending verification, active or on hold; a removed method does not count. The rails may be mixed freely.

| Imagined holding (hypothetical) | Methods counted | Within the limit of 10 |
|---|---|---|
| 6 active, 2 on hold, 1 pending verification, 3 removed | 9 | Yes |
| 8 active, 2 on hold | 10 | Yes, at the limit |
| 9 active, 1 on hold, 1 pending verification | 11 | No |

## Clause 3 as conditions

A rail may be added only when every applicable condition holds:

| Condition | Read from |
|---|---|
| The country of the host's bank or receiver profile is one of the rail's available countries | The rail's country list |
| The payout currency is one of the rail's supported currencies | The rail's currency list |
| Where the rail requires a name match, the method is in the host's legal name or the account's business name | The rail's name-match requirement, the host's legal name and the business name on the host account |

**Hypothetical example.** An imagined host whose bank is in Canada and who wishes to be paid in CAD meets the country and currency conditions of a rail only if that rail lists Canada among its countries and CAD among its currencies; if either list lacks it, that rail may not be added for that bank and currency.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a removed method still count toward the 10?* No; the limit counts methods in any status other than removed.
- *Which method is the default when a host adds their very first method?* That first method.
- *Can a host have two default methods?* No; exactly one active method is the default at any time.
